candidates.requirement: Decode every fuzz-controlled gzseek whence within the bounds of the selector array.
candidates.target_route: With bytes 00 77 04 05, mode_sz is 2 and the mode is "w". The first selector, 0x77, selects case 15; the second selector, 0x04, selects gzseek; 0x05 indexes whences[5].
candidates.failure_condition: whences has five elements, but the selector is reduced modulo six. Index five is outside the array before gzseek receives its argument.
candidates.alternative_paths: For this input the two-operation loop and switch select the same decoder; no default, alias, or later call avoids the out-of-bounds read.
